Home.heroTitle: One brief in. A whole drop out.
Home.heroLead: wovain researches what your audience wants this week, designs products for your Fourthwall catalog, and builds the Meta ads to sell them. You approve every step; the campaign launches paused.
Home.briefLabel: What should your next drop be about?
Home.briefPlaceholder: Cozy outdoorsy merch for my houseplant channel
Home.briefHint: One sentence is enough. You can change everything later.
Home.noCard: You connect Fourthwall and Meta after you sign up.
Home.deckLabel: An example drop as a fan of ink swatches
Home.deckCaption: A demo drop, step by step

brief.name: Brief
brief.value: Cozy merch for a plant channel

Home.howLead: Every drop goes through the same press. Each step ends with something you can see and approve, built from real Fourthwall blanks, prices and margins.

trends.name: Trends
trends.body: Qloo's taste graph finds what your fans also love; Tavily checks this week's news and the listings already out there.

designs.name: Designs
designs.body: Candidate artwork for each pick, checked by NVIDIA Nemotron for print size, colors and listing rules before you see it.

approve.name: Approve
approve.body: Approve, reject or say what to change. Feedback makes a new round; nothing moves on without a yes.

fourthwall.name: Fourthwall
fourthwall.body: Approved designs become products on real blanks, priced to clear at least $10 profit per sale after fees.

meta.name: Meta ads
meta.body: Nemotron writes 2 or 3 ad variants, each from a different angle. wovain builds one campaign with an ad per variant, created paused so you decide when to spend.

Home.autopilotTitle: Autopilot runs the same press with fewer stops
Home.autopilotLead: Turn on autopilot and wovain takes the top picks, approves designs that pass every check, publishes and builds the campaign. It still launches paused, and every run is in your history.
Home.surfacesTitle: Works in ChatGPT and on the web
Home.surfacesLead: The same agents and the same approvals, wherever you work.
Home.chatgptBody: Add wovain as an app and ask for a drop in plain words. Approvals appear as cards in the chat.
Home.chatUser: Make a drop for my plant channel. Cozy, outdoorsy, nothing too punny.
Home.chatAssistant: I found 4 picks. Moss and fern cottagecore scores highest: fans of plant channels also love slow living, and few shops sell it as type. Want designs for it?
Home.webBody: A step-by-step wizard with run history, connections and an autopilot switch.
Home.poweredLead: wovain does the orchestration. These do the heavy lifting.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: wovain is a hackathon project. We keep as little as we can, and we never sell data.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, email and password hash for your account; the briefs you write; and the runs, designs and products wovain makes for you.
privacy.connectionsBody: When you connect Fourthwall, Meta or fal, we store the access they grant so wovain can act for you. You can disconnect any of them at any time from Connections.
privacy.processorsBody: Briefs and designs are sent to the services that do the work: Nebius, Qloo, Tavily, fal, Fourthwall and Meta. Each handles data under its own policy.
privacy.deleteBody: Email privacy@wovain.com from your account's address and we delete your account, runs and stored connections within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: By using wovain you agree to these terms.
terms.useBody: wovain is provided as is, during a hackathon, without warranty. Features may change or stop.
terms.contentBody: You own your briefs and the designs you approve. You are responsible for making sure what you publish does not infringe anyone's rights; wovain screens for trademarks but cannot guarantee it.
terms.spendBody: Campaigns are created paused. Any ad spend starts only when you turn a campaign on in Meta, and it is billed by Meta to your ad account.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms go to hello@wovain.com.

brief.title: Write the brief
brief.label: What should this drop be about?
brief.hint: Say who it's for and the feel. wovain does the research.

trends.title: Pick the ideas
trends.lead: Scored by taste affinity, this week's momentum and how crowded the listings are. The top idea already has a design.

designs.title: Approve the designs
designs.lead: Approve the ones you'd sell. Reject with a note, then make another for the same idea.
designs.reasonPlaceholder: Make the type bolder, drop the leaves

products.title: Publish the products
products.lead: Real Fourthwall blanks, priced to clear at least $10 profit per sale after fees. They stay hidden until you publish.
products.error: Publish at least one product first.

campaign.title: Build the campaign
campaign.lead: One campaign per product with an ad per copy variant. It's created paused: nothing spends until you turn it on in Meta.
campaign.budgetHint: Between $1 and $500 a day. You can change it in Meta.
campaign.budgetError: Enter a daily budget from $1 to $500.

done.lead: {count, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}} at {budget} a day. Turn it on in Meta Ads Manager when you're ready to spend.
